metaTitle: Nágila Bernarda Zortéa | Aesthetics, Science and Education in Erechim
metaDescription: Nágila Bernarda Zortéa — Master's degree, Aesthetician, Coordinator of the Aesthetics and Cosmetology Program and Advanced Aesthetics Postgraduate at URI Erechim. Researcher, speaker, and owner of NZ Beauty Clinic in Erechim, RS, Brazil.

sobre.label: About
sobre.title: A trajectory built between the clinic, academia, and science.
sobre.bio1: Nágila Bernarda Zortéa holds a Master's degree and works as an Aesthetician and Professor, coordinating the Undergraduate Program in Aesthetics and Cosmetology and the Postgraduate Program in Advanced Aesthetics at URI Erechim — Universidade Regional Integrada do Alto Uruguai e das Missões.
sobre.bio2: Her practice combines individualized clinical care with scientific rigor. As an author of publications in national peer-reviewed journals and a speaker at reference events in Brazilian aesthetics — including the Estetika, Latin America's largest aesthetics event —, Nágila represents a new generation of professionals who place science at the foundation of aesthetic practice.
sobre.bio3: She is also an entrepreneur and the owner of NZ Beauty Clinic, in Erechim, Rio Grande do Sul, where academic and clinical expertise translates into excellence in aesthetic care.

role1.title: Aesthetics Professional
role1.desc: Aesthetician with a solid scientific background, working at the intersection of cosmetology, clinical aesthetics, and evidence-based practice. Specialist in facial and body aesthetics.

role2.title: Professor and Coordinator
role2.desc: Master's-level Professor and Coordinator of the Aesthetics and Cosmetology Program and Advanced Aesthetics Postgraduate at URI Erechim, contributing to the training of aesthetics professionals in Rio Grande do Sul.

role3.title: Researcher
role3.desc: Author of scientific publications in indexed national journals, including the Brazilian Journal of Plastic Surgery (SciELO), with research on aesthetics technologies, acne, melasma, and cosmetology.

role4.title: Speaker
role4.desc: Participant in leading scientific and professional events in the aesthetics field, including the Estetika — Latin America's largest aesthetics event —, advocating for a science-based aesthetic practice grounded in clinical reasoning.

role5.title: Entrepreneur
role5.desc: Owner of NZ Beauty Clinic, an aesthetics clinic located in the center of Erechim, Rio Grande do Sul, where academic and clinical expertise translates into excellence in care.

pub1.title: Technical Differentiation and Innovation in Contemporary Liposuction: A Critical Study of the Postoperative Period in Light of New Technologies
pub1.abstract: A critical review of technological innovations in contemporary liposuction, evaluating efficacy, safety, and postoperative management. Analyzes VASER, Renuvion, BodyTite, Morpheus8, and Argoplasma, highlighting the need for evidence-based clinical protocols. Published in RBCP, journal of the Brazilian Society of Plastic Surgery.
pub1.linkScieloAriaLabel: Access article on SciELO (opens in new tab)
pub1.linkThiemeAriaLabel: Access article on Thieme (opens in new tab)

pub2.title: Use of radiofrequency for aesthetic treatments: a systematic review
pub2.authors: NB Zortéa, ABN de Mattos, CFG Neto et al.
pub2.abstract: Systematic review of the clinical use of radiofrequency in aesthetic treatments, analyzing 11 studies on different modalities and indications. Addresses the most prevalent aesthetic condition identified and the efficacy of the technology.
pub2.linkAriaLabel: Access article on Academia.edu (opens in new tab)

pub3.title: Mask-induced acne vulgaris
pub3.authors: NB Zortéa, ABN Mattos et al.
pub3.abstract: Study on the development of acne vulgaris associated with continuous use of protective face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic, investigating pathogenic mechanisms and clinical and aesthetic management approaches.
pub3.linkAriaLabel: Download article in PDF (opens in new tab)

pub4.title: Microbiological contamination of in-store lipstick testers available to the consumer
pub4.authors: NB Zortéa, M Vassoler, LG Rossato-Grando et al.
pub4.abstract: Investigation of microbiological contamination in lipstick testers available in retail establishments, highlighting public health risks and the importance of sanitary regulations for collectively used cosmetic products.
pub4.linkAriaLabel: Access article in O Mundo da Saúde journal (opens in new tab)

pub5.journal: Proceedings of the Research and Extension Integration Seminar
pub5.title: Biochemical Factors of Melasma
pub5.abstract: Study on the biochemical mechanisms of melasma, a highly recurrent skin hyperpigmentation disorder with significant impact on patients' self-esteem and quality of life.

event1.title: "Integrative view on health beyond the skin"
event1.imageAlt: Nágila Bernarda Zortéa speaking at the 32nd Estetika, Latin America's largest aesthetics event, São Paulo, 2026
event1.location: São Paulo Expo — São Paulo, SP · Jul 31 – Aug 2, 2026
event1.desc1: Lecture presented at the Symposium on Precision Facial Aesthetics at the 32nd edition of the Estetika — Latin America's largest aesthetics event, with 134 speakers, 89 hours of content, and more than 180 exhibiting brands. Nágila addressed acne as a possible manifestation of systemic imbalances, advocating for an aesthetic practice grounded in science, individualized assessment, and clinical reasoning.
event1.desc2: She also participated in the roundtable discussion "Hot Topics in Facial Aesthetics", alongside João Tassinary, Lucas Portilho, Luiz Rabelo, Priscilla Sebbe, and Daniela Moleiro.
event1.quote: "Being at Estetika as a speaker represents not just a professional achievement, but also the opportunity to bring URI's name to one of the most relevant spaces in aesthetics in Latin America and to contribute to the strengthening of an increasingly scientific and responsible practice."
event1.sourceAriaLabel: View news on the URI Erechim website (opens in new tab)

event2.eventName: Estética in Sul · VIASOFT EXPERIENCE · Curitiba, PR
event2.title: "Post-operative Interventions. Fibrosis: How to Manage and Treat"
event2.imageAlt: Nágila Bernarda Zortéa at the Estética in Sul Aesthetics Congress, Curitiba, August 2026
event2.location: VIASOFT EXPERIENCE — Curitiba, PR · Aug 17, 2026 · 5:14 PM – 5:54 PM
event2.desc1: Lecture presented at the Aesthetics Congress of Estética in Sul 2026, held at VIASOFT EXPERIENCE, Curitiba. Nágila addressed aesthetic interventions in post-operative care, focusing on the management and treatment of fibrosis — a highly relevant clinical topic in contemporary body aesthetics.
event2.desc2: Presented as Me. Nágila Zortéa (RS) — Aesthetician and Cosmetologist, Postgraduate in Advanced Clinical Aesthetics, Specialist in Orthomolecular Medicine, Ozone Therapy, and Higher Education Teaching, Master's in Human Aging.

faq1.a: Nágila Bernarda Zortéa holds a Master's degree and is an Aesthetician, Coordinator of the Aesthetics and Cosmetology Program and the Advanced Aesthetics Postgraduate Program at URI Erechim. She is also a researcher, speaker, and owner of NZ Beauty Clinic in Erechim, Rio Grande do Sul.

faq2.q: Which program does Nágila Zortéa coordinate?
faq2.a: Nágila Bernarda Zortéa coordinates the Undergraduate Program in Aesthetics and Cosmetology and the Postgraduate Program in Advanced Aesthetics at URI Erechim (Universidade Regional Integrada do Alto Uruguai e das Missões, Erechim Campus, Rio Grande do Sul).

faq3.q: Where is NZ Beauty Clinic located?
faq3.a: NZ Beauty Clinic is located at Rua Cezária Matos, 82, Centro, Erechim/RS, ZIP 99700-094. For contact and bookings: (54) 99651-6136 or on Instagram @nz_beautyclinic.

faq4.a: Yes. In 2026, Nágila presented the lecture "Integrative view on health beyond the skin" at the 32nd edition of the Estetika — Latin America's largest aesthetics event —, held at São Paulo Expo. She also participated in the roundtable "Hot Topics in Facial Aesthetics". See the events section for more information.

faq5.q: What scientific publications feature Nágila Zortéa?
faq5.a: Nágila Bernarda Zortéa (NB Zortéa) has published work in national journals, including: "Technical Differentiation and Innovation in Contemporary Liposuction" (RBCP, 2026, DOI: 10.1055/s-0046-1820097); "Use of radiofrequency for aesthetic treatments: a systematic review" (2021); "Mask-induced acne vulgaris" (2021); "Microbiological contamination of in-store lipstick testers" (O Mundo da Saúde, 2020); and "Biochemical Factors of Melasma" (URI Erechim). See the publications section for direct links.

faq6.q: What is Nágila Zortéa's role at URI Erechim?
faq6.a: Nágila Bernarda Zortéa is a Master's-level Professor at URI Erechim, where she coordinates the Undergraduate Program in Aesthetics and Cosmetology and the Advanced Aesthetics Postgraduate Program. Her work encompasses teaching, scientific research, and university extension, training aesthetics professionals with a solid scientific foundation in Rio Grande do Sul.

faq7.q: What services does NZ Beauty Clinic offer?
faq7.a: NZ Beauty Clinic offers Facial Aesthetics, Body Aesthetics, Laser Hair Removal, Post-operative Care, and Lipedema treatment. Services are provided by Nágila Bernarda Zortéa, Master's-level Aesthetician, at Rua Cezária Matos, 82, Centro, Erechim/RS. Contact via (54) 99651-6136 or Instagram @nz_beautyclinic.

faq8.q: How to book an appointment at NZ Beauty Clinic?
faq8.a: To book an appointment at NZ Beauty Clinic, contact via WhatsApp (54) 99651-6136, Instagram @nz_beautyclinic, or visit linktr.ee/nagi_estetica. The clinic is located at Rua Cezária Matos, 82, Centro, Erechim/RS.
